user.title: Hackable Desk Clock
user.description: Enter the clock's address: deskclock-xxxx.local or its IP address. You'll confirm on the clock itself.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Set up {name}
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found {name} at {host}. Click Submit, then press BOOT on the clock to allow Home Assistant.

key.title: API key for {name}
key.description: Enter the clock's API key, shown at the bottom of its setup page (hold BOOT for 3 seconds to open setup mode).

reauth_confirm.title: Pair with {name} again
reauth_confirm.description: The clock rejected the saved API key (its settings may have been erased). Click Submit, then press BOOT on the clock to allow Home Assistant again.

progress.press_button: The clock is showing the code **{code}**. If it matches, press BOOT on the clock to allow Home Assistant. Double-press BOOT to cancel.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the clock. Check the address and that the clock is on your WiFi.
error.invalid_auth: The clock rejected that API key.
error.setup_mode: The clock is in setup mode. Let it rejoin your WiFi, then try again.
error.firmware_too_old: The clock's firmware is too old for Home Assistant. Reflash it with current firmware, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This clock is already set up.
abort.firmware_too_old: The clock's firmware is too old for Home Assistant. Reflash it with current firmware.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That address belongs to a different clock.

show_notification.name: Show notification
show_notification.description: Shows a card over the clock face. It replaces any card already showing and goes away after the duration, or when BOOT is pressed.

message.name: Message
message.description: Up to 80 characters. Only plain letters, digits and punctuation can be drawn.

level.name: Level
level.description: Info is green and warning is amber (both use the clock's night colour at night). An alarm is bright red, pulses and ignores night mode.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds to show the card, or 0 to keep it until it is dismissed. Default: 30.

id.name: ID
id.description: A name for this card, so Dismiss notification can remove just this one.

dismiss_notification.name: Dismiss notification
dismiss_notification.description: Removes the card from the clock.

id.name: ID
id.description: Only remove the card if it was shown with this ID. Leave empty to remove whatever is showing.
